props.gloss_en: what difference does it make [that they are harmful]? to ask for mercy
but in the morning -- there is no substance in them
R' Shmuel bar Yitzchak: these morning clouds have no substance in them
as it is written: 'and your goodness is as a morning cloud...' (Hos 6:4)
the folk saying: when the doors open [to] rain, donkey-driver, fold your sack and sleep
thunder was created only to straighten the crookedness of the heart
as it is said: 'and God has made it so that they fear before Him' (Eccl 3:14)
one who sees the rainbow in the cloud must fall on his face
as it is said: 'as the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud... and I saw, and I fell on my face' (Ezek 1:28)
because it looks like one who bows down to the bow
but to bless -- he certainly blesses
what does he bless? 'Blessed... who remembers the covenant'
R' Yishmael son of R' Yochanan ben Beroka: 'faithful to His covenant and steadfast in His word'
Rav Pappa: therefore let us say them both: 'Blessed... who remembers the covenant, and is faithful to His covenant and steadfast in His word'
